auth.panelText: Everything you need to pay and manage your people, in one place.
auth.featurePayroll: Every kind of payroll: monthly, weekly, daily and hourly workers, with taxes and statutory deductions worked out for you.
auth.featurePhones: Payslips and leave requests on every employee's phone.
auth.featurePerformance: Performance management: goals, check-ins and reviews.
auth.featureTasks: Task management: assignments, and checklists for people joining and leaving.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.intro: It takes a minute. You'll set up your organization next.
signUp.contactHint: You'll use it to sign in.
signUp.passwordHint: Use 8 or more characters, mixing letters with numbers or symbols.
signUp.terms: By continuing you agree to our terms and privacy notice. We process staff data under Kenya's Data Protection Act.

validation.contact: Enter a valid email address or Kenyan phone number.
validation.passwordWeak: Use at least 8 characters, mixing letters with numbers or symbols, and avoid common passwords.
validation.orgName: Enter your organization's name (2 to 120 characters).
validation.companyName: Enter the company's legal name (2 to 160 characters).

organization.title: What's your organization called?
organization.intro: Just a name to start. You'll add your companies next.
organization.name: Organization name
organization.nameHint: The name your team knows you by. Legal company names come in the next step.
organization.noOrgTitle: You don't have an organization yet.
organization.noOrgText: Set one up now to get started.

noOrganization.title: You're not part of an organization
noOrganization.text: If you think this is a mistake, ask an administrator in your organization to add you back.

companies.title: Your companies
companies.intro: Add each company that employs people and pays them. Payroll runs for each company separately.
companies.emptyText: Most organizations start with one. We've filled in your organization's name; change it to the company's legal name.
companies.countryHint: The numbers below depend on the country.
companies.missingNotice: Companies with missing numbers can't run payroll until they're added. You can add them now or later.
companies.needOne: Add at least one company to continue.
companies.deleteText: Its details and statutory numbers will be deleted. This can't be undone.
companies.legalNameHint: As registered, the way it appears on statutory returns.
companies.numbersIntro: The numbers a company in {{country}} registers with. Missing ones don't stop you saving, but payroll needs them.

payingAccounts.title: Paying accounts
payingAccounts.intro: Where this company's payroll is paid from. Bank and M-Pesa files use it as it's saved here, so it can't be changed in the file.
payingAccounts.none: No paying account yet. This company can't run payroll until it has one.
payingAccounts.removeText: It stays on record for past payrolls but won't be used again.
payingAccounts.bankHint: A bulk payment file for your bank.
payingAccounts.mpesaHint: A B2C shortcode that sends pay to phones.
payingAccounts.accountNameHint: As the bank has it, usually the company's legal name.
payingAccounts.shortcodeHint: The B2C shortcode Safaricom gave you for paying salaries.
payingAccounts.bankRequired: Choose a bank from the list.
payingAccounts.branchRequired: Choose a branch of this bank from the list.
payingAccounts.accountNameInvalid: Enter the name on the account (2 to 120 characters).
payingAccounts.accountNumberInvalid: Enter the account number: 6 to 20 digits.
payingAccounts.shortcodeInvalid: Enter the M-Pesa shortcode your payroll is paid from (5 to 7 digits).
payingAccounts.firstIsDefault: The first account is always the default.
payingAccounts.defaultLocked: To change the default, turn this on for another account.
payingAccounts.defaultHint: Payroll is paid from the default unless you choose another account.

locations.title: Where do your people work?
locations.intro: Add your head office, branches and sites. Each company has one main location; the county and town decide which minimum wages and holidays apply.
locations.emptyText: Add one, or choose other companies above.
locations.mainHint: Each company has one main location. Ticking a company here moves its main location to this one.
locations.deleteText: It will be removed for every company that uses it.
locations.name: Location name
locations.codeHint: Leave it empty and we'll make one, like MOM-01.
locations.nameInvalid: Enter the location's name (2 to 120 characters).
locations.codeInvalid: Use 2 to 20 letters, numbers or dashes, or leave it empty for us to make one.
locations.companiesRequired: Choose at least one company, or all companies.
locations.templateHint: One row per location: name, type, code (optional), county, town, address, and Yes in Main location for the one that should be the main location.
locations.importMainHint: The row marked Main location becomes the main location of the companies you choose.

bulk.fileHint: An .xlsx or .csv file with the template's columns, up to 1,000 rows. You'll review and fix the rows before anything is saved.
bulk.toCreate_one: {{count}} new item will be created when you import.
bulk.toCreate_other: {{count}} new items will be created when you import.
bulk.tooManyValues: Showing the first {{count}} values. Search to narrow them.
bulk.wrongType: Only .xlsx or .csv files can be imported. {{name}} isn't one: choose the template or a .csv file.

structure.title: How is your organization organised?
structure.intro: Add the departments people work in and the positions they're hired into. Divisions and units are optional. Each can be for all companies or chosen ones.
structure.partOfHint: The department this one sits under. Leave it empty for a top-level department.
structure.sharedHint: Leave it empty for a position used across departments, like Driver.
structure.unitDepartmentRequired: Choose the department this unit is in.
structure.codeHint: Leave it empty and we'll make one from the name.
structure.deleteText: It will be removed for every company that uses it.

divisions.nameInvalid: Enter the division's name (2 to 120 characters).
divisions.emptyText: Optional: group departments across companies, like Restaurants and Catering.
divisions.templateHint: One row per division: its name and, if you like, a code.

departments.nameInvalid: Enter the department's name (2 to 120 characters).
departments.emptyText: Add the departments people work in.
departments.templateHint: One row per department: name, code (optional), division (optional) and Part of: the department it sits under, which can be another row of the file.

positions.nameInvalid: Enter the position's title (2 to 120 characters).
positions.emptyText: Add the jobs people are hired into.
positions.templateHint: One row per position: title, code (optional) and the department it is in (leave it empty for a position used across departments).

units.nameInvalid: Enter the unit's name (2 to 120 characters).
units.emptyText: Optional: teams or shifts inside a department.
units.templateHint: One row per unit: name, code (optional) and the department it is in.

schedules.title: When do you pay your people?
schedules.intro: Each company has a default schedule, which its employees get unless you choose another. We've set up Monthly, paid on the last working day. Add weekly, every-two-weeks or daily schedules for people paid more often.
schedules.emptyText: Add one, or choose other companies above.
schedules.defaultHint: Each company has one default schedule. Ticking a company here moves its default to this schedule.
schedules.deleteText: It will be removed for every company that uses it.
schedules.name: Schedule name
schedules.nameInvalid: Enter the schedule's name (2 to 60 characters).

ruleHints.last_working_day: The Friday before when the month ends on a weekend.
ruleHints.last_day: Even when it falls on a weekend.
ruleHints.fixed_day: The Friday before when it falls on a weekend.

schedules.payDayInvalid: Choose a pay day from 1 to 28.
schedules.cutoffHint: The last day of the month that changes count toward this month's payroll.
schedules.previewHint: Weekends are skipped. Public holidays aren't yet, so check these dates.
schedules.companiesRequired: Choose at least one company, or all companies.
schedules.firstPayDateHint: Every two weeks counts from this date.
schedules.cutoffBeforeHint: How many days before the pay day changes stop counting toward this payroll.
schedules.payTimeHint: Daily pay runs every working day; there's no cut-off.
schedules.cutoffHelp: A cut-off is the last day changes count toward this payroll. Anything after it, like overtime or a new employee's first days, is paid in the next payroll. Turn it off if everything up to pay day is paid on pay day.
schedules.appliesToHint: Changes to these after the cut-off go into the next payroll.
schedules.appliesToRequired: Choose at least one thing the cut-off applies to, or turn the cut-off off.
schedules.addItemTitle: Add what the cut-off applies to
schedules.remindersHint: Get a reminder to run payroll before pay day, by email or SMS.
schedules.maxReminders: A schedule can have up to 5 reminders.
schedules.phoneInvalid: Enter a Kenyan mobile number, like 0712 345 678.
schedules.remindersDontFit: A reminder doesn't fit how often you pay. Change or remove it.

leavePlans.title: What leave do your people get?
leavePlans.intro: Kenya's legal minimums are already in a Standard plan. Add plans for people paid weekly, daily or by the hour, and your own kinds of leave.
leavePlans.emptyText: Add one, or choose other companies above.
leavePlans.yearTotalWorked: = {{days}} days a year if they work every working day
leavePlans.startFromHint: Fills in the leave; you can change any of it.
leavePlans.planNameInvalid: Enter the plan's name (2 to 80 characters).
leavePlans.leaveYearHint: When yearly leave is given and carry-over happens.
leavePlans.hoursPerDayHint: Turns days into hours and back, for leave counted in hours.
leavePlans.hoursPerDayInvalid: Enter the hours in a working day, from 1 to 24.
leavePlans.companiesRequired: Choose at least one company, or all companies.
leavePlans.defaultHint: Each company has one default plan. Ticking a company here moves its default to this plan.
leavePlans.defaultForSchedulesHint: People on these schedules follow this plan, before their company's default.
leavePlans.halfPayHint: After the days above, more on half pay (sick leave: 7 + 7).
leavePlans.prorate: Share for people who join during the year
leavePlans.prorateHint: Someone joining on 1 July gets half the year's leave.
leavePlans.carryOver: Most carried into the next leave year
leavePlans.waiting: Months of service before it can be used
leavePlans.lawFullHalf: {{name}} in Kenya is at least {{full}} days on full pay and {{half}} on half pay a year.
leavePlans.lawYear: {{name}} in Kenya is at least {{full}} days a year.
leavePlans.lawEach: {{name}} in Kenya is at least {{full}} days each time.
leavePlans.lawWaiting: {{name}} can be used after {{months}} months' service in Kenya, not later.
leavePlans.lawWaitingNone: {{name}} can be used from the start in Kenya.
leavePlans.lawWorkedWarning: Over a full year this is {{days}} days, less than the law's {{full}}. Check it's right.
leavePlans.commonHint: Fills in the form; you can change anything.
leavePlans.name: Name
leavePlans.codeHint: Leave it empty and we'll make one, like COM-01.
leavePlans.codeInvalid: Use 2 to 20 letters, numbers or dashes, or leave it empty for us to make one.
leavePlans.paidHint: People are paid as usual while on this leave.
leavePlans.needsProofHint: For example a doctor's note or a birth certificate. Leave requests will ask for it.
leavePlans.lockedNote: Set by law: its name and how it's counted can't change.
leavePlans.deletePlanText: People on it will need another plan.
leavePlans.deleteTypeText: It can only be deleted when no plan has it.

payItems.title: What do you pay, and what comes off pay?
payItems.intro: Basic pay and what the law takes (PAYE, SHIF, NSSF, Housing Levy, NITA) are already here and worked out for you. Add your own allowances, deductions and employer costs.
payItems.emptyText: Add one, or choose other companies above.
payItems.name: Name
payItems.codeHint: Leave it empty and we'll make one, like HOU-01.
payItems.codeInvalid: Use 2 to 20 letters, numbers or dashes, or leave it empty for us to make one.
payItems.workedPlaceholder: Your way of working it out
payItems.taxedHint: Added to the pay PAYE is worked out on. Almost all earnings are taxed; turn this off only for things like reimbursed expenses.
payItems.beforeTaxHint: Comes off pay before PAYE is worked out, like a registered pension. The law's limits apply.
payItems.defaultAmountHint: Suggested for each person; you can change it per employee.
payItems.defaultAmountInvalid: Enter an amount of 0 or more, or leave it empty.
payItems.companiesRequired: Choose at least one company, or all companies.
payItems.commonHint: Fills in the form; you can change anything.
payItems.deleteText: It will be removed for every company that uses it.

sources.bank_account: The bank account they're paid into
sources.mpesa_number: The M-Pesa number they're paid into

employees.title: Who works for you?
employees.intro: Add your people one by one, several at once, or upload a spreadsheet. Payroll needs each person's KRA PIN, ID number, basic pay and where to pay them.
employees.searchPlaceholder: Your search: name or staff number
employees.emptyText: Add someone, add several, or upload a spreadsheet.
employees.deleteText: Only for someone added by mistake. For someone who has left, set the date they left instead.
employees.staffNoHint: Leave it empty and we'll make one, like EMP-01.
employees.exitDateHint: Only for someone who has left. They stay in Pesaroll for P9A cards and history.
employees.nationalIdHint: 7 or 8 digits, or 9 for a Maisha Namba.
employees.kraPinHint: A, 9 digits and a letter, like A012345678Z. Needed for PAYE.
employees.nssfNoHint: 7 to 10 digits, from their NSSF card.
employees.shaNoHint: From the Social Health Authority: letters, digits and dashes.
employees.saved_: Saved: {{masked}}. Type a new one to change it.
employees.lineManagerHint: People in the same department come first.
employees.leavePlanHint: Their schedule's plan, or the company's, unless you choose another.
employees.amountInvalid: Enter an amount more than 0, or leave it empty for now.
employees.keepAccount: Saved: {{masked}}. Leave it empty to keep it.
employees.templateHint: One row per person. Departments, divisions and positions that don't exist yet are created. Line managers go by staff number and can be in the same file; leave the schedule and leave plan empty for the company's own.
employees.exitDateRequired: Enter the date they left, or tick Still works here.
employees.amountHint: Paid {{frequency}}, as their payroll schedule says.
employees.paysByHint: {{company}} pays by {{method}}, so this is needed for people who work here.
employees.uploadCompanyHint: The template's lists (schedules, leave plans, structure, banks) are this company's.

rules.kraPin: Enter a KRA PIN like A012345678Z: A, 9 digits and a letter.
rules.nationalId: Enter 7 or 8 digits, or 9 for a Maisha Namba.
rules.shaNo: Use 6 to 20 letters, digits or dashes.
rules.phone: Enter a Kenyan mobile number, like 0712 345 678.
rules.email: Enter an email address, like name@company.co.ke.
rules.mpesa: Enter a Safaricom number for M-Pesa, like 0712 345 678.
rules.staffNo: Use up to 20 letters, digits, dashes or slashes.
rules.accountDigits: Enter the account number in digits.
rules.paysByBank: {{company}} pays by bank: add their bank details.
rules.paysByMpesa: {{company}} pays by M-Pesa: add their M-Pesa number.
rules.exitDate: Enter the date they left, or tick Still works here.
rules.paysByEither: Add their bank details or M-Pesa number.

employees.addressHint: Where they live, like Hse 12, Kilimani, Nairobi.
employees.noMatches: No one matches the search and filters. Change or clear them.
employees.payItemsNone: Only basic pay and what the law takes.

who.title: Who gets it
who.noCompany: Choose a company under Details first.
who.question: Who gets it at {{company}}?
who.everyoneHint: Everyone there now, including people hired later.
who.eachRun: {{name}} is entered each payroll: this says who can have it.
who.untilHint: Optional, such as a loan's last month.
who.findHint: Name, staff number, phone, email, NSSF or SHA number, or a whole ID number or KRA PIN.
who.noMatches: No one at this company matches.
who.nobodyChosen: Find people above and add them.
who.deleteAlso: It's given to: {{who}}; that goes too.
who.noEndHint: Leave Until empty when it has no end date; From empty starts it today.
who.byLaw: Everyone: it's set by law, so it applies to every employee.
who.missing_one: {{count}} person has no {{what}} in their profile yet: {{names}}.
who.missing_other: {{count}} people have no {{what}} in their profile yet: {{names}}.

payees.paidToHint: Who the money goes to, such as a SACCO, union, insurer or lender.
payees.name: Name
payees.nameHint: Such as Stima SACCO. One payee can be used by several items.

methodHints.bank: To their bank or SACCO account.
methodHints.cheque: A cheque made out to them.

payees.paybillAccountHint: What goes in the paybill's account box.
payees.ourReferenceHint: Such as your employer code at the SACCO.
payees.profileDetailHint: Taken from each person's profile when they're given an item paid to this payee.
payees.profileDetailRequired: Choose which detail of their profile to use.
payees.enteredFor: Account numbers are entered for each person, as set on {{payee}}.
payees.pickedFrom: Account numbers are picked from each person's {{what}}, as set on {{payee}}.
payees.fromProfile: Pick each person's account number from their employee profile
payees.fromProfileOffHint: Off: you enter each person's member or account number, or give the payee's account details.
payees.fromProfileOnHint: On: taken from each person's profile, such as their ID number (HELB uses it) or the bank account they're paid into.
payees.intoOwnAccount: Into each person's own account (from their profile)

history.title: Bring in your payroll history
history.intro: Upload what your previous system paid, month by month, so this year's totals and P9A tax cards start complete. You can skip this step.
history.uploadCompanyHint: The history is for this company's employees. People not in Pesaroll are added as former employees.
history.templateHint: One row per employee per month, from January two years ago up to last month: who (employee number, KRA PIN or ID number), the month (YYYY-MM) and what they were paid and deducted.
history.emptyText: Upload what your previous system paid, one row per employee per month, so year-to-date totals are right from your first Pesaroll payroll.
history.deleteText_one: Its {{count}} row of payroll history is removed. People it added stay, as former employees.
history.deleteText_other: Its {{count}} rows of payroll history are removed. People it added stay, as former employees.

rules.required: Enter this, or 0 if there was none.
rules.amount: Enter an amount of 0 or more, like 85,000.
rules.month: Enter the month as YYYY-MM, like 2026-01.
rules.monthTooLate: Payroll history goes up to {{last}}: Pesaroll runs payroll from {{first}}.
rules.monthTooEarly: Payroll history starts from {{first}}. Leave out earlier months.

invite.title: Join {{organization}}
invite.intro: {{inviter}} invited you to join as {{role}}, for {{companies}}.
invite.existing: You already have a Pesaroll account with {{contact}}. Enter its password to join.
invite.cantUseIntro: Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

team.title: Who else will use Pesaroll?
team.intro: Invite the people who help run your payroll and HR. Each gets a group, which decides what they can do, for all your companies or chosen ones. You can skip this step.
team.name: Name

groupHints.administrators: Everything, including inviting people and changing their access.
groupHints.payroll: Employees, earnings and deductions, payees, paying accounts, payroll schedules and payroll history.
groupHints.approvers: Sees your companies; approves pay runs once payroll runs in Pesaroll.

team.emptyText: Invite someone, or show other companies.
team.onlyAdministrators: Only administrators can see and change who uses Pesaroll. Ask one of them to add or change people.
team.cancelText: The link in their message stops working. You can invite them again later.
team.removeText: They can't sign in to your organization any more. Their past changes stay. You can invite them again later.
team.contactHint: The invitation goes to their email, their phone by SMS, or both.
team.contactNeeded: Enter their email address or mobile number, so the invitation can reach them.
